title: Larry Smalley joins Ning Li; NASA capacitor patent

tellings.quote: but then we found out since that Larry Smalley who was the head of the physics department at University of Alabama Huntsville goes and joins her.

plain: According to Jesse Michels, a physicist named Larry Smalley, head of the physics department at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, went to join a physicist named Ning Li in her work, which Michels links to anti-gravity research. He ties it to a 2004 NASA patent for an asymmetric, bell-shaped capacitor, an electrical device of the kind some people say can produce thrust. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign the research went on quietly with serious scientists involved.
